biggest_catch: The reward is only $10 - small, but honest - and the friend must mention your referral during the account/loan opening or hand your referral card to a FORUM employee, or it doesn't count.
catches: Referring member and the friend each receive $10 deposited into their accounts once qualifications are met.
Friend must open a new FORUM checking, savings, or loan product ($50 minimum deposit for deposit accounts).
Friend must mention the referral during the account/loan opening; the referral card must be given to a FORUM employee at the time of opening.
Health and secondary checking accounts excluded; new loans only (no refinances of current FORUM loans).
Accounts must be in good standing; allow 4-6 weeks for the deposit.
No cap stated on the official page.
No tax language on the page (standard bonus treatment; not stated).
